subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can make regular and irregular past simple verbs: played, tried, had, went.
I can make negatives and questions: I didn't use a tablet. Did you have a phone?
I can tell a short story about the past with time words like two days ago.

tf.s: The past simple of have is had.
The past simple of try is tryed.
"Did you have a phone?" "Yes, we did." is correct.

tf.why: After didn't, use the base verb: They didn't drink water.

tf.s: The past simple of go is went.
"Ten years ago" and "last month" are time words for the past.
tf.why: Great! They tell us when something happened.

tf.s: The past simple of wear is weared.
Regular verbs add -ed in the past: play → played.
We use "were" with he and she: She were happy.
tf.why: We say she was; were is for you, we and they.

tf.s: The past simple of eat is eated.

boxes.q: Faisal's dad ___ to the beach with his family. (go)
Make it negative: I used a tablet.
___ you have a phone ten years ago?

boxes.why: drink → drank in the past simple.

boxes.q: She went to the lake. She ___ to the river.
Did you play football yesterday? No, I ___.
We ___ at the beach last weekend.
Which is a time word for the past?
boxes.why: Ago tells us about the past.

mcq.q: Which list has only irregular past forms?
What is the past simple of drink?
Which is a correct short answer to "Did you have a phone?"
Which time words talk about the past?
o: last month, a long time ago, ten years ago
mcq.why: These words tell us when in the past.

mcq.q: Make a question: you / have a phone / ten years ago
o: Did you have a phone ten years ago?
Did you had a phone ten years ago?
Do you had a phone ten years ago?
You did have a phone ten years ago?

mcq.q: Write about last weekend: one positive and one negative sentence.
o: I visited my grandma. I didn't play computer games.
I visit my grandma. I don't play computer games.
I visited my grandma. I didn't played computer games.
I visiting my grandma. I not play computer games.

mcq.q: Describe a day out yesterday. Which sentence is correct?
o: It was hot, so I wore a hat.
It were hot, so I weared a hat.
It is hot, so I wore a hat yesterday.
It was hot, so I wear a hat yesterday.
The verb ends in a consonant + y, so y changes to i.

mcq.q: Find the mistake: "They didn't drank water."
mcq.why: After didn't, we use the base verb.

mcq.q: Which sentence is about the past?
o: I used a mobile phone two days ago.
I use a mobile phone every day.
I'm using a mobile phone now.
I'm good at using a mobile phone.
mcq.why: used + two days ago shows the past.
